market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $150 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI $150 HIGH by end of June requires +$42 from current $108. Historically WTI hit $147 in 2008 super-spike. Even with Iran action, $150 by end-June is a tail event - it would require Strait of Hormuz closure or major supply shock. Possible but low probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severity of Middle East escalation - actual blockade of Strait of Hormuz could send WTI to $150+ rapidly.
